top_choice_rationale: P001 awards the GLP-1 physiology and active-peptide achievement to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. It runs from hormone physiology to replicated outcome evidence in large independent randomized trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity, so maturity is not in question, and the citation rests on physiology and the active peptide forms rather than on specific drugs. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question and the exclusion of Knudsen are real attribution risks, but they do not outweigh the case for awarding the prize, so no award (P000) ranks below it.
